MoAI-ADK 2026.11.0-rc.1 — agentic development kit

Usage: moai <command> [options]
       moai cc|codex|glm -l|-a    lead or agent session

Start
  cc                      Start a Claude Code session
  codex                   Start a Codex CLI session
  glm                     Start a Claude Code session on
                          z.ai GLM
Project
  project-detect          Detect the project's facts
  project-plan            Preview the project profile
  project-apply           Write a previewed project profile
  language-setup          Choose the writing language item
                          by item
  index-build             Build the code map index
  agents-plan             Preview the AGENTS.md managed
                          section
  agents-apply            Write a previewed AGENTS.md
                          managed section
  generation-plan         Preview the project's generated
                          agent and skill files
  generation-apply        Write previewed generated agent
                          and skill files
  github-plan             Preview the project's GitHub
                          templates
  github-apply            Write previewed GitHub templates
  labels-plan             Preview syncing the project's
                          GitHub labels
  labels-apply            Sync previewed GitHub labels
  claude-settings-plan    Preview the managed Claude Code
                          settings keys
  claude-settings-apply   Write previewed Claude Code
                          settings keys
  codex-config-plan       Preview the managed Codex config
                          keys
  codex-config-apply      Write previewed Codex config keys
  hooks-plan              Preview the MoAI hook set for one
                          host
  hooks-apply             Write a previewed hook set
  hooks-revert            Undo the hook set one update
                          applied
  go-hooks-plan           Preview replacing Go-era project
                          hooks
  go-hooks-apply          Replace Go-era project hooks
  go-hooks-revert         Undo a Go-era hook replacement
Update and move
  update                  Update MoAI from the installed
                          package
  go-state-plan           Preview moving the Go-era .moai
                          folder
  go-state-apply          Move a previewed Go-era .moai
                          folder
  go-state-revert-plan    Preview undoing a Go-era folder
                          move
  go-state-revert         Undo a Go-era folder move
  home-state-plan         Preview moving the Go-era ~/.moai
                          folder
  home-state-apply        Move a previewed Go-era ~/.moai
                          folder
  home-state-revert       Undo a ~/.moai folder move
  worktree-move-plan      Preview moving this clone's
                          worktrees
  worktree-move-apply     Move the previewed worktrees
  update-plan             Preview an update of every host
                          copy
  update-apply            Apply a previewed update host by
                          host
  cleanup-plan            Preview archiving leftover MoAI
                          files in HOME
  cleanup-apply           Archive the previewed leftover
                          MoAI files
  cleanup-revert-plan     Preview undoing one HOME cleanup
  cleanup-revert          Undo one HOME cleanup
  recovery-plan           Preview recovering hosts an update
                          left pending
  recovery-apply          Revert one update's changes on
                          pending hosts
  apply-recover           Revert the files one apply
                          published
  layout-plan             Preview moving MoAI state into the
                          home layout
  layout-apply            Copy MoAI state into a previewed
                          home layout
  migrate-plan            Preview migrating Go MoAI data on
                          a test HOME
  migrate-apply           Apply a previewed Go MoAI
                          migration
  migrate-recovery-plan   Preview undoing one migration
                          apply
  migrate-recover         Remove the imports one migration
                          apply made
  skills-legacy           List legacy moai-* skill folders
  bin-names-plan          Preview the moai link beside
                          moai-cli
  bin-names-apply         Make the previewed moai link
  agents-home-plan        Preview installing the base agents
                          into HOME
  agents-home-apply       Install previewed base agents into
                          HOME
  agents-home-revert      Undo one base agent install
  home-routing-plan       Preview the routing section in

  home-routing-apply      Write a previewed routing section

                          in HOME

Keys

                          showing it

                          vault
  key-import-plan         Preview importing an old key file
  key-import-apply        Import a previewed old key file
Diagnose

  baseline-inventory      List a checkout's baseline facts
Lane and leader

                          comment

                          commit or push
  claim-timeout-check     Check the three timeout takeover

                          cancelled

  queue-free              List the open cards a lane may
                          take

                          leader's comment

  lane-next               Find the lane's next task
  lane-loop-line          Print a lane's wake line for its
                          host
  lane-stop-hook          Answer a Codex lane's Stop hook
  lane-resume-note        Write a card's resume note
  lane-resume-check       Read a card's resume note from a
                          comment
  lane-duty-line          Print the line a leader types into
                          a lane
  lane-status             Show the status table of the named
                          lanes
  lane-handoff-check      Check that a worktree is safe to
                          leave
  lane-safe-to-reset      Check that a lane's session is
                          safe to clear
  close-check             Check whether an Issue may close
  lane-env                Print a lane's cargo folders
  session-register        Register this session's lane name
  usage-limit             Report how close the usage limits
                          are
  heavy-slot-acquire      Run a heavy command in a

  heavy-slot-status       List the heavy-run slots held now

  goal-plan               Preview a change of the standing
                          goal

                          standing goal

                          the state

  gate-merge              Merge one pull request when the
                          gate passes

  gate-schedule-plan      Preview a scheduler entry for
                          gate-loop
  gate-schedule-apply     Write a previewed gate-loop
                          scheduler entry
  wait                    Wait until a condition holds on
                          GitHub

  worktree-plan           Preview the branch and worktree of

                          claim

  audit-verdict-line      Print the verdict first line for
                          the audited head
  audit-clone-plan        Preview an independent audit clone

                          the rule
  decision-due            Sort the unanswered decisions of a
                          bundle

                          against the WIP cap
  dispatch-record         Record a dispatch revision
  dispatch-ack            Record a dispatch acknowledgement
                          and decision

                          acknowledgements
  message-record          Publish a durable message
  message-ack             Publish a receiver acknowledgement

  effect-intend           Record an external write before it

  effect-confirm          Confirm or mark uncertain an
                          intended write
  effects-reconcile       Reconcile uncertain writes with
                          the remote

                          audit

                          are posted
  repo-scans              List the repo-wide scan tests a
                          merge must run
  pr-self-audit-check     Check a pull request body's
                          Self-Audit section
  flake-classify          Classify flaky tests from two CI
                          logs
  flake-record            Record classified flaky tests on
                          their Issues
  audit-delta             Compare a two-parent merge with a
                          replay
  audit-reduce            Run an independent audit of a
                          candidate
  parity-check            Compare a template and its
                          generated files
  plan-admit              Admit a plan to a run
  run-verify              Re-check a run's pinned
                          verification
Internal
  statusline              Render the Claude Code status line
  hook-receipt            Record one hook receipt line
  hook-dispatch           Run one MoAI hook duty for a host
  forge-read              Read GitHub Issues and comments as
                          tasks
  forge-links-probe       Probe the GitHub sub-issue and
                          dependency APIs
  forge-report            Create or update a run's report
                          comment
  forge-audit-status      Post the audit commit status on a
                          SHA
  index-query             Query the code map index
  atlas-map               Show the code map
  atlas-graph             Walk the code graph from a symbol
  atlas-tag-scan          Scan for MOAI and MX tag markers
  search                  Search paths, symbols and text
  context-bundle          Bundle file ranges with digests
  context-verify          Re-check a bundle's ranges against
                          the files
  decision-record         Append one decision record to a
                          run
  cost-report             Sum the cost items of run receipts
  snapshot-describe       Describe a project's HEAD and
                          tracked changes
  package-inspect         Inspect a skill package's digests
  package-resolve         Resolve which skill package a
                          project uses
  codex-projection-plan   Preview a Codex copy of the skill
                          package
  codex-projection-apply  Install a previewed Codex skill
                          copy
  project-skill-plan      Preview project copies of the moai
                          skill
  project-skill-apply     Copy the moai skill into the
                          project
  project-skill-revert    Undo one project skill copy
  archive-plan            Preview which SPECs can be
                          archived
  archive-apply           Archive the previewed SPECs
  archive-restore         Restore one archived SPEC
  archive-search          Search the archived SPECs
  worktree-gc-plan        Preview removing or trimming

  session                 Start a Claude Code session
                          (legacy form)

Options:
  -l, --leader
          Start a leader session on the default host (cc)
  -a, --agent [<HOST>]
          Start an agent session on HOST (cc|glm|codex;
          default cc)
      --color <WHEN>
          Color on a terminal: auto, always (even with
          NO_COLOR or TERM=dumb) or never; put it before the
          command
      --name <NAME>
          Session name (default `leader` for -l, the
          project's next `agent-N` for -a; none without a
          role)
      --model <MODEL>
          Main model (Claude hosts default `opus`; codex
          uses its own default unless set)
      --effort <EFFORT>
          Claude effort (default `medium`)
      --advisor <ADVISOR>
          Advisor model on Claude hosts (fable|opus|sonnet
          or a full claude-* id). None by default; the user
          setting `launcher.advisor` can turn it on. May
          bill to usage credits
      --no-advisor
          Pass no `--advisor` even when the user setting
          `launcher.advisor` turns it on
      --permissions
          Keep permission prompts: no
          `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (Claude hosts)
          and the `workspace-write` / `on-request` sandbox
          on codex. Without it a -l|-a session has full
          access; a session without a role never gets a
          permission flag
      --dry-run
          Print the composed command as JSON instead of
          starting the host
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version

Run 'moai <command> --help' for details and examples.
